newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 20 bln levs T-bills Aug 30, Sept 2.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 20 bln levs T-bills Aug 30, Sept 2.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will offer a total of 20 billion levs worth of T-bills in three separate issues dated September 4 at auctions on Friday and on Monday, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
"Part of the funds raised at the auctions will be used to cover maturity payments on previous issues due on September 4," a BNB official told Reuters.
Two of the new T-bill issues with a total par value of 7.0 billion levs are discount bills with maturity of three months and 49 days respectively.
The third one is a six-month floater coupon issue with a par value of 13 billion levs and it was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry, the BNB said.
Its coupon was set equal to the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity. The CIR is now 108 percent.
Three previous issues of treasury bills - one coupon and two discount ones with a total par of 22.7 billion levs - mature on September 4, BNB data shows.
Par value 4.0 bln levs 3.0 bln levs 13 bln levs
